intro.what: Open-source terminal AI coding agent (Anomaly, TS; 2.0 rewrite runs on Node)
intro.trust: Config permission maps + policies gate every tool action; deny .env*, ask doom_loop/external dirs

cards.what: Native Agent Skills: SKILL.md folders the model loads on demand
cards.manage: none — file drop · config skills[] paths · catalog URL
cards.autoupdate: Yes — catalog caches per version; bump = update. Most registry-ready
emission: alt: add catalog URL to config skills[] (v2)

cards.what: Markdown slash commands — reusable prompt templates
cards.manage: none — file drop; or commands[] config array (v2)
cards.autoupdate: No — file drop / commands[] config; replace by hand

cards.what: Markdown sub-agent definitions with own model and permissions
cards.autoupdate: No — replace the .md by hand; CLI only scaffolds
emission: built-ins: build plan general explore scout

cards.what: No hooks file — event reactions live in TypeScript plugins
cards.manage: opencode plugin add · list · check · update · remove
cards.autoupdate: Yes when the codegen'd plugin ships on npm: plugin update
cards.why: hook spec → codegen TS plugin module

cards.what: TypeScript modules that hook events and add custom tools
cards.manage: opencode plugin add pkg@ver · list · check · update
cards.autoupdate: Yes — opencode plugin update; npm pkg@version pins
cards.why: bundle → npm TS adapter plugin pkg
emission: publish npm pkg; opencode plugin add <pkg>@<ver>

cards.what: Standard external tool servers connected via stdio or HTTP
cards.format: JSON entry: local command/env · remote url/headers
cards.autoupdate: No — manual config edit or re-run opencode mcp add

cards.what: Language-server support: just a config key and plugin events
cards.where: config lsp key · plugin events only
cards.format: none documented — lsp key shape unspecified
cards.manage: none — no LSP CLI or registration documented
emission: lsp config key exists; schema undocumented

cards.what: Extra agent tools defined in TypeScript plugins via tool()
cards.autoupdate: Yes — tools update with their plugin (plugin update)
cards.why: tool spec → codegen TS plugin tool()
emission: ship inside plugin pkg; override built-ins

cards.what: No statusline surface; themes are the adjacent JSON drop
cards.manage: none — /themes selects; theme file drop only
cards.autoupdate: No surface. Themes update only by file drop
cards.why: opencode.md documents themes only, no statusline

cards.what: Config rules saying which tool actions are allowed or must ask
cards.autoupdate: No — manual config edit; org .well-known can push policies
